summary: A Deira real estate office appears to lose enquiries to a one page site, a free builder address and a 2021 date.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix footer that says Proudly created with Wix.com.
findings.cost: A free builder address and a Wix footer look temporary for an office trading since 1996.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a branded footer.

findings.problem: The page appears to carry a 2021 copyright date.
findings.cost: An old date makes buyers wonder if the office is still active.

findings.problem: The homepage text appears short and mixes Arabic into an English sentence, and I did not see any property listings.
findings.cost: Buyers and tenants come to see properties, and a page with none sends them to the big portals.
findings.fix: Property listings with photos and filters, in English and Arabic.

findings.problem: The menu appears to be Home, Book Online, Contact and About, with no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Renters message first, and the office that replies first wins the viewing.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button and an enquiry form.
